title: Iran war drives India’s cockroaches out, but can Modi crush them?
summary: When an Indian student at a US university used AI to create the “Cockroach Janta Party (CPJ)”, a parody political party, it sparked a viral sensation, hitting the zeitgeist in a country that has been particularly affected by the Iran war.
